project_type: Node.js/TypeScript Express API gateway + React 18/TypeScript/Vite admin SPA, npm workspaces monorepo
language: TypeScript (strict via tsconfig.base.json; admin panel: jsx=react-jsx, moduleResolution=Bundler, noEmit=true; api-gateway: module=commonjs, strict=true)
build_system: Admin panel: Vite 5 (vite.config.ts must be created — not yet present). Build: `npm run build` = `tsc && vite build`. Dev: `npm run dev` = `vite`. API gateway: tsc for build, ts-node for dev/scripts. Root: npm workspaces.
test_framework: Admin panel: vitest 2 + @testing-library/react 16. Command: `cd apps/admin-panel && npm run test` (vitest run --passWithNoTests). API gateway: Jest 29 + ts-jest. Command: `cd services/api-gateway && npm test`.
test_command: cd apps/admin-panel && npm run typecheck && npm run test
verification_instructions: 1. cd apps/admin-panel && npm run typecheck — expect 0 TypeScript errors. 2. cd apps/admin-panel && npm run test — all vitest tests pass (--passWithNoTests). 3. cd apps/admin-panel && npm run build — dist/ created, 0 errors. 4. cd services/api-gateway && npm run typecheck — 0 errors after adding admin.ts. 5. cd services/api-gateway && npm run build — 0 errors.
snapshot_or_generated_files: apps/admin-panel/dist/ is generated by vite build. Not checked in.
environment_constraints: Admin panel has NO installed node_modules yet (only package.json exists). The implementer must run `cd apps/admin-panel && npm install` before building. Do NOT add new dependencies — only use packages already in package.json: react 18, react-dom 18, react-router-dom 6.26.1, react-i18next 15, i18next 23, @safiriharaka/shared-types (*). devDeps: vite 5, @vitejs/plugin-react 4, typescript 5, vitest 2, @testing-library/react 16, fast-check 3. API gateway: app.listen() is NOT called in src/index.ts — it exports `default app`; a separate server.ts or Vercel adapter calls listen.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md. Keep all admin panel changes under apps/admin-panel/. Keep all api-gateway changes under services/api-gateway/. Never push to main — commit locally on the working branch.
key_patterns: API gateway auth: src/routes/auth.ts signs JWT as { userId, userType } and stores decoded on req.user via src/middleware/auth.ts. In admin route handlers, access the user as `(req as any).user?.userType === 'admin'` (NOT req.user.type — that is set by a different auth middleware shape). Route files import pool from '../database/connection'. Pattern: `const result = await pool.query('SELECT ...', [param1])` then `res.json(result.rows[0])`. safeUse() in src/routes/index.ts registers routes; add admin there. Admin panel fetch pattern: native fetch() with Authorization Bearer header; token stored in localStorage key 'admin_token'. React Router v6 data router: createBrowserRouter + RouterProvider + nested layout with Outlet. i18next: inline resources, synchronous init with initReactI18next — no HTTP backend.
directory_structure: apps/admin-panel/ — package.json, tsconfig.json, src/services/AdminAPI.ts (only existing src file; has broken import, must be replaced). No index.html, no vite.config.ts, no src/main.tsx yet. services/api-gateway/src/ — index.ts (exports app, no listen), routes/ (25 files + index.ts, no admin.ts yet), middleware/auth.ts (requireRole helper), database/connection.ts (exports pool). migrations/ — 001, 008, 009, 010, 011 exist; 014 must be created. packages/shared-types/src/index.ts — exports UserType enum (Admin='admin'), UserStatus, etc.
